t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on UI mockup: a warm limestone sheet on a deep navy frame. Top left: a large light-weight sans headline and a mono uppercase sub-label. Left 60%: a five-row table with mono cells and hairline rules for <CONTENT>. Right: a large circular dial of fine radial ticks with one steel-blue index tick, cropped by the sheet edge, holding an oversized light mono numeral with its unit and a short linear tick scale; one steel-blue horizontal limit line crosses it with small outlined mono limit tags. Flat, square corners, calm.
signature_idea: A signals table set beside one oversized live readout: a light mono numeral in a tick-ring dial crossed by a single limit line.
strengths: readout is a strong, ownable instrument motif that fits the brand
mono numerals, light headline and one steel-blue accent match the brand book
dial is easy to build in SVG and animate
weaknesses: dial shows one value while the table lists five signals; the link is implied only
whole table in mono is heavy for prose cells
invented figures and clause numbers in cells and readout
limit tags have slightly rounded corners
dial cropped by the sheet edge feels accidental
brand_fit_why: Limestone on navy, light headline, mono figures, a single steel-blue limit line and a precise tick dial are the brand book's instrument idea almost exactly.
